An athlete runs 300 metres up a hill at a steady speed of 3.0m/s.
She then immediately runs the same distance down the hill at a steady speed of 6.0m/s.
What is her average speed for the 600 metre run?
A
2.0m/s
B
3.0m/s
C
4.0m/s
D
4.5m/s
subject: Physics
